{{Otheruses|Bantha}}
'''''Taskforce Bantha''''' was the codename given to [[Booster Terrik]]'s group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ships and independent freighters during the [[Battle of Qretu 5|attack]] on [[Qretu 5]]'s bacta refinement plant.<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

After neutralizing all of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] defenses, the ships landed on the spaceport and took all the [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] they could load.<ref name="bacta" />
